name: Orders Sync for HubSpot CRM
author: machhichintan

sections.description:
Orders Sync for HubSpot CRM automatically creates a deal in your HubSpot CRM whenever a store order is placed. Easily map deal stages, pipelines, and more from your WordPress admin.

Compatibility

  • Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/machhichintan-orders-sync-hubspot-crm/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the HubSpot Settings screen to configure the plugin
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require a HubSpot account?

Yes, you need a HubSpot account and API key.

Can I choose the deal stage and pipeline?

Yes, you can set these in the plugin settings.
